title: Yeasty Tender Vietnamese Pork Bun Thit Nuong
description: A yeasty, tender, and comforting Vietnamese dish featuring Massaman paste, air-fried to perfection, and served in a bun, this recipe is Ayurvedic Tamasic friendly.
instructions: In a large bowl, combine sliced pork, Massaman paste, fish sauce, and brown sugar, and marinate for at least 30 minutes.
In a separate bowl, proof the yeast by mixing it with warm water and letting it sit for 5 minutes.
Add the yeast mixture to the bun dough and knead for 10 minutes until smooth and elastic.
Divide the dough into 4 equal pieces and roll each into a ball.
Flatten each ball into a disk shape and brush with vegetable oil.
Air-fry the pork at 400 degrees Fahrenheit for 10 minutes, or until cooked through.
Assemble the buns by spreading a layer of pickled carrots on the bottom, followed by a few slices of pork, and topping with cilantro.
Store any leftover buns in an airtight container in the refrigerator for up to 3 days.
